architecture.state_input: shared chat context; attempt after10s from previous completion; actual interval depends on inference

automatic_lora.method: CPU NF4 QLoRA; rank8 q_proj/v_proj; FP32 compute
automatic_lora.kv_reset: only after successful new-weight load, before next inference resumes

helper_comparison.metric: Source contract, not general model accuracy. R2 corrects omissions with explicit source rules; not evidence of a learned weight improvement.
helper_comparison.method: Same loaded model and adapters, thinking off, cache_prompt=false. Baseline reused from preceding paired run; no controlled repeated timing confidence interval.

limitations: Synthetic scenarios were used during debugging; most are regression cases, not an independent general benchmark.
Memory retrieval was disabled in these task-continuity comparisons to isolate the changed path; production retrieval remains available.
The agent can still omit explanation details; preserving evidence does not guarantee correct language reasoning.
Read-only enforcement applies to explicit current-turn restrictions; it is not a universal natural-language intent classifier.
Earlier paired pilot advertised420 chars with a200-char schema. Do not use its total-answer latency as a clean production comparison.

cpu_kernel_scope: October31 benchmark with a different main adapter; not a promise of current end-to-end latency or output speed improvement

novel_reader.runtime_error: BudgetExceeded: Mandatory request/state is too large
completed_features: actual self and independent tests executed
uncompleted_features: bounded file-path reading for long novels
novel_reader.current_instruction: observe only; no continuation or repair instruction sent
